morphology.formula: mencampur + -i → mencampuri；完整构词：meN- + campur + -i → mencampuri
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入的直接基础词 mencampur；最底层词根为 campur。meN- 在 c 前变为 men-，c 保留；添加 -i 时词干不变。

senses.zh_definition: 往某物中添加另一种东西，使其混合。
senses.en_definition: To add another substance to something, making a mixture.
senses.ms_definition: Menokok atau menambah sesuatu supaya bercampur.
senses.nuances: 宾语可表示接受添加物的主体。描述掺水、掺杂时可带负面含义；一般烹调混合也常用 mencampurkan。词义依据：[Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=campur)。

collocations.zh: 往黄金中掺入其他金属
collocations.en: to mix gold with other metals

senses.zh_definition: 与另一物质混合；混入某物之中。
senses.en_definition: To mix with or become mingled with another substance.
senses.nuances: 强调某物进入混合状态，与上一义的主动添加有所不同。此物质义在现代日常表达中常以 bercampur 代替；以下搭配用于说明词义。

collocations.en: an ingredient mixed into the curry

senses.zh_definition: 介入、干涉或插手某项事务，尤其是他人的事务。
senses.en_definition: To intervene in or interfere with an affair, especially someone else's.
senses.ms_definition: Turut campur dalam sesuatu urusan atau hal orang lain.
senses.nuances: 现代常见义。是否带贬义取决于权限、动机和语境；涉及私人事务时通常有越界意味。

collocations.en: to interfere in other people's affairs

senses.zh_definition: 与某人或某群体交往、相处。
senses.en_definition: To associate or mingle with people.
senses.ms_definition: Bergaul atau bersama dengan seseorang atau sesuatu golongan.
senses.nuances: 词典收录的交往义；现代口语通常用 bergaul dengan，避免被理解为干涉。

collocations.en: to mingle with the local community

senses.zh_definition: 与某人发生性关系；常用于夫妻关系的委婉表达。
senses.en_definition: To have sexual intercourse with someone.
senses.nuances: 委婉而较书面，见于婚姻、宗教及传统叙述；不是日常表达交往的首选。

collocations.en: to have intercourse with one's wife
not yet to have consummated the marriage

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak pengurusan tidak akan mencampuri urusan peribadi pekerja selagi perkara itu tidak menjejaskan tugas mereka.
dual_scenarios.zh: 只要员工的私人事务不影响工作，管理层就不会介入。
dual_scenarios.en: Management will not intervene in employees' private affairs as long as they do not affect their work.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tak payahlah kita mencampuri urusan dia, biar dia selesaikan sendiri je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tidak perlulah kita mencampuri urusannya; biarkan dia menyelesaikannya sendiri.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我们就别插手他的事啦，让他自己解决吧。
dual_scenarios.en: Let's stay out of his business and let him sort it out himself.
spoken_features: tak payahlah 表示口语中的劝止
je 对应 sahaja，带有限定和缓和语气
口语中也常以 campur 或 masuk campur 表达此义

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak tolong, tapi takut dia fikir aku mencampuri urusan dia pulak.
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu membantu, tetapi bimbang dia pula menganggap saya mencampuri urusannya.
messages.zh: 我想帮忙，可又怕他觉得我在多管闲事。
messages.en: I want to help, but I'm worried he'll think I'm meddling.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tanya dia dulu je. Kalau dia tak nak bantuan, kita bagi ruanglah.
messages.ms_standard: Tanya dia dahulu. Jika dia tidak mahu menerima bantuan, berilah dia ruang.
messages.zh: 先问问他就好。他要是不想让人帮，我们就给他点空间吧。
messages.en: Just ask him first. If he doesn't want help, give him some space.

etymology.historical_story: The base campur links physical mixture with social involvement. Mencampuri preserves that connection across substances, human association, interference and an intimate euphemism. These dictionary senses offer a cultural picture of boundaries: ingredients can enter a mixture, while people can enter another person's affairs. This is a semantic connection, rather than a documented chronology of how each meaning developed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 campur＝混合：东西混进去是掺入，人混进别人的事务就是插手。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 Jangan mencampuri urusan saya 容易显得严厉。需要维护关系时，可说 Terima kasih atas perhatian, tetapi biarlah saya uruskan perkara ini sendiri。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 评论家庭、婚姻或同事私事时注意界限。涉及人与人时，应根据宾语区分干涉、交往和性关系三种意思。
